title: Aharonov-Casher Chern bands for ultracold dark state atoms
summary: We consider the Aharonov-Casher (AC) condition for ultracold atoms adiabatically following the dark-state in a $Λ$-type atom-light coupling scheme. The AC condition establishes a relation between the geometric scalar potential and the synthetic magnetic field, resulting in a fully degenerate lowest Landau-level-like band in the adiabatic limit even if the magnetic field is inhomogeneous but has a proper sign.
